facts.text: Enrolled in the David Sullivan–St. Lawrence County Law Enforcement Academy as a pre-employment student to complete his senior-level internship, Apr 2023

Served as faculty mentor for Clarkson University's Summer 2026 SDIP REU project integrating VR, IMUs and EEG with the GaitSIT walking-balance assessment

Practices as a physician assistant at St. Mary's Regional Hospital in Grand Junction, Colorado, part of Intermountain Health, with the medical group Colorado Surgical Affiliates
Named a researcher on Clarkson University's prospective study of symptoms in people with and without joint hypermobility (IRB 26-36), 2026
Completed her APTA Fellowship in Higher Education Leadership capstone project on faculty development in teaching and learning for Clarkson's DPT program, Jul 2026
